summary.en-US: Configurable publisher watchlists and formal post-publication signals for scholarly literature.

version.approval_notes: Notandia is the public successor to MDPI Filter. Firefox has not previously been released; this first submission uses the new Gecko ID browser-extension@notandia.github.io. The package is generated from the public repository without minification, bundling, remote code, or runtime npm dependencies. Publisher-profile matching is local. Built-in MDPI and Frontiers profiles are configurable and independently deactivable; custom profiles accept validated names, domains, DOI prefixes, colors, confidence policies, and actions only. Integrity checks remain disabled on Firefox until the user explicitly enables them and grants the optional websiteContent data permission. When enabled, normalized DOI identifiers are sent to Crossref, including reverse updates:<doi> queries where needed. Page URLs, search queries, page/citation text, cookies, account identifiers, analytics identifiers, and referrers are not sent. Requests are bounded and active requests are cancelled when lookups are disabled or navigation begins. Privacy policy: https://mdpi-filter.pages.dev/privacy/firefox/
